title: Check through baggage on seperate qff EK tix
body:
O.P.
Hi all, hoping for some guidance here. I’m about to make separate QFF bookings on Emirates to London through Dubai. One flight will be economy and the next in business with only 2 hours between flights My question is will my baggage be checked through to the second flight? The Qantas website seems to say no if it’s EK/EK but I was hoping to double check. Qantas states:
What if I am travelling on separate tickets? oneworld flights on separate tickets/bookings are not eligible for through check–in, except if you have a Qantas Frequent Flyer reward or Qantas commercial booking, advise airport staff at check-in of the booking references. QF/QF and QF/EK flights on separate tickets/booking - through check-in is eligible and boarding passes will be issued.
Thanks for any advice

---- replies ----
[User #742437067 postsTheDocWhirlpool Forums Addict] Emirates will allow this, yes. Have a printout of your second flight details (in particular, the PNR, but worth having the whole thing) and at check-in tell the agent what you're after.
[User #5093112011 postsAmbulance chaserFinally on fibreWhirlpool Forums Addict] Qantas and EK throughcheck on separate tickets. Suggest flying to SIN and picking up business class on EK there though.
If doing it on points, use the multi-city booking tool to pop everything on the one ticket.
https://agencyconnect.qantas .com/en-au/policies/baggage- information/interline-and-th rough-checked-baggage

zipzip writes...
Thanks for any advice
I have had this my last two long hauls – the most critical one for me was the last flight when only had 90 minutes before Dubai to Cairo – the Syd Dubai in premium and and the Dubai Cairo in business – long story why they were seperate tickets but no issue at all in getting baggage checked through to Cairo (both qf tickets ek metal )
The system may not allow it if timings are tight however you have 2 hours I will be surprised if it does not happen good luck and let us know
Btw I have a similar but different one in September – Syd – hkg – pvg first flight qantas ticket qantas metal second one Cathy flight number , Cathy metal – both seperate tickets on points – just read the doc above looks like I may have a issues but plenty of time in Hong Kong if needed
